# Native binding can publish while its resource is retiring

## Context and problem

The [#18304 seam account](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/18304#issuecomment-5563564532) identifies Workstation's `admitTearOutConnection` retirement predicate as generic correctness logic. A [direct owner probe](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/18304#issuecomment-5564217392) on merged `dev@a4dc6c9441` now shows why the Group owner needs the rule: `NativeLifecycle.onBind()` calls `bound` and publishes a connection even when the resource's close is pending, both when retirement starts before bind and when it starts during awaited preparation. The no-retirement control binds normally.

## Architectural reality and fix

`NativeLifecycle` owns admissions, connections and pending retirements per registered source. Its existing post-`prepare` checks reject revoked admissions and withdrawn sources, but do not reject a still-retiring resource until close acknowledgment removes the admission.

Check the current source/resource retirement state before preparation and again before publication. Keep the check live across the await, using the owner loop's `sourceId`. Remove Workstation's standalone generic retirement override; preserve the base's optional product admission hook.

Demo-B already rechecks retirement around its own awaited geometry/staging work. That is precedent for the timing invariant, but its local staging/restore checks stay: an owner publication guard cannot unwind side effects performed inside a consumer's preparation callback. No new module or wire field is needed.

| Surface | Authority | Required behavior | Fallback | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Native connection admission | NativeLifecycle's source-local admission and retirement records | No preparation/publication for an already-retiring resource; no publication if retirement starts during preparation | Retain exact close/retry authority; allow unrelated sources/resources | Deferred-close and deferred-prepare unit controls |

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A retirement pending before bind prevents preparation, `bound`, and connection publication.
- [ ] Retirement beginning during awaited preparation prevents `bound` and connection publication; retirement remains retryable until exact close acknowledgment.
- [ ] The no-retirement path and unrelated resources/sources still bind. Regression cases fail on the original owner.
- [ ] Workstation's generic retirement override is deleted, with focused owner/consumer tests passing and the generated size baseline reflecting the deletion.

## Out of scope

Demo-B's private staging/restore choreography, `admitDockPopOut`, theming, native close policy, broader decomposition, and changes to the approved reader or pointer-test deliveries.

Decision Record impact: aligned with ADR 0029's Group-owned native lifecycle; no amendment.

## Prior art and ownership

Fresh latest-20 open issues and latest-30 all-state A2A messages checked immediately before creation at 2026-09-07 02:37 UTC. Grace confirmed this seam unclaimed and supplied the Demo-B timing precedent; no competing implementation found. Eight own open issues checked; #18303/#18428/#18435 own different acceptance work. Three targeted MC queries surfaced prior canceled-admission controls (`aea04d76`), and the final pending-close query returned unrelated older context. Current owner source and the executable probe remain the premise authority. Euclid takes this bounded source/consumer deletion under #18304.
